1.web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
1.asv: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

2.web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
2.asv: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.

3.web: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
3.asv: For ye died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

4.web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
4.asv: When Christ, who is our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.

5.web: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
5.asv: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

6.web: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
6.asv: for which things’ sake cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience:

7.web: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;
7.asv: wherein ye also once walked, when ye lived in these things;

8.web: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
8.asv: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:

9.web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
9.asv: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,

10.web: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
10.asv: and have put on the new man, that is being renewed unto knowledge after the image of him that created him:

11.web: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
11.asv: where there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondman, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

12.web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
12.asv: Put on therefore, as God’s elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;

13.web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
13.asv: forbearing one another, and forgiving each other, if any man have a complaint against any; even as the Lord forgave you, so also do ye:

14.web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
14.asv: and above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfectness.

15.web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
15.asv: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.

16.web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
16.asv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto God.

17.web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
17.asv: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

18.web: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
18.asv: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

19.web: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
19.asv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

20.web: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
20.asv: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.

21.web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
21.asv: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.

22.web: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
22.asv: Servants, obey in all things them that are your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing the Lord:

23.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
23.asv: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;

24.web: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
24.asv: knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the recompense of the inheritance: ye serve the Lord Christ.

25.web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
25.asv: For he that doeth wrong shall receive again for the wrong that he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
